content: Sakkeus
Bade Isa Zeriku šohoror butottu di zar.
Ar so, heṛe ekzon Sakkeus name manuš aššil. Hite oilde ekzon hazna adaigoroya okkolor mazi, ek tuwangor manuš.
Ar hite Isare saito kušiš goijje, kintu hite baiṭṭa buli manušor zamot Isare sai no fare.
Toi hite Isare sai farefan, mum mikka dũri zai ek ḍũir gasor uwore uiṭṭe, kiyollahoile Isa he fõt bai gil.
Bade Isaye zẽtte he zagat fõisse, hetunot Isaye uwor mikka sai hitare hodde,

content.text: "Sakkeus, toratori lami ai, kiyollahoile aijja ãttu tor górot taka foribo."

content: Henot Sakkeuse toratori lami aišše edde Isare kušir sãte mehemandari kobul goijje.
Kintu hen deki beggune monmonaiye, "Isaye ekzon gunagaror górot rait haṛaito zar."
Kintu heṛe Sakkeuse tiyai malik Isare hodde, "Malik so, ãr šombottir oddok ãi gorib okkolore dir. Ar zodi oinnai bafe honokiyor hono kissu ṭokai taki, toile hinor ãi sairgun firai diyum."
Hetunot Isaye hitare hodde:

content.text: "Uddar aijja ei górot aišše, Sakkeus o ekzon Ibrahimor šontan.
Kiyollahoile zara hãzi giyegoi hitarare talaš edde basaibolla Adomor Fut aišše."

content: Doššan šunar mohoror kahani
Ar zara Isar hota funnil hitarare Isaye šikka dibolla ekkan mesal kahani hoiye, kiyollahoile Isa zeṛe aššil hentu Zeruzalem beši dure nuwaššil. Ar mainše mone goijje Allar raijjo hara deha zaibo.
Isaye hodde:

content.text: "Ek usol bongšor manuše razagiri firai anibo hoi ek duror dešot giye.
Ar hite hitar nizor došzon gulamore ḍaki fottizonore ekkan ekkan šunar mohor diyore hodde, 'Ãi zeto din foijjonto firi no aiyi, in diyore šodori goijjo.'
"Kintu hitar dešor mainše hitare hingša goitto, hitara hitar fise manuš defeṛaiye endilla hoibolla, 'Ãra no sai, ei manušwa ãrar raza ok!'

"Zen oibo ok, ei manušware raza banaiye edde hite górot uwafes firi aigiyegoi. Toi hite ze gulam okkolore ṭĩya dil, hitara šodorit hone hodun amodoni goijje hin saibolla he gulam okkolore hitar hãse ḍaikke.
"Toi foila ekzon ai hodde, 'Malik, tũwar ekkan šunar mohore aro doššan šunar mohor hamaiye.'
"Razaye hitare hodde, 'Bala goijjos tui ãr bala gulam! Kiyollahoile tui oti šoṛo hamot o biššaš dehaiyos etolla doššan šohoror uwore šašon goribar kemota dilam.'
"Toi dusora ekzon aišše edde hodde, 'Malik, tũwar šunar mohor loi aro fãssan mohor ãi hamaiyi.'
"Toi razaye hitare hodde, 'Tore o fãssan šohoror uwore šašon goribar kemota dilam.'
"Bade ar ekzone aiyore hodde, 'Malik, doro tũwar šunar mohorgan. Ãi iyan fakit nummalot bandi raki dilam.
Ãttu tũware ḍor laigge, kiyollahoile tui ekzon hora manuš, zin no rako hin tũi tuli lo, edde zin no lago hin haṛo.'
"Hite hitare hodde, 'O horaf gulam, ãi tor mukor hota loi tor bisar goriyum. Tui to ãi hora manuš de zaniti, zin no raki hin ãi tuli edde zin no lagai hin ãi dai.
Henoile ãr ṭĩya udar loyare kiya no dos, hen goriti buli ãi aile šudor fũwati hin uwafes adai gori faittam?'
"Toi heṛe aro zara tiyai aššil hitarare hite hodde: 'Itar hãsottu šunar mohorgan loifelo edde zattu doššan mohor ase hitare iyan o do.'
"Hitara hodde, 'Malik, hitattu de age loti doššan mohor ase!'
"Malike hodde, 'Ãi tũwarare hoir, zattu ase, hitare aro diya zaibo, kintu zattu nai, hitattu asede hin o loifela oibo.
Tũwara zo! He dušmon okkol zara ãi raza oi no sa, hitarare eṛe ano edde ãr šaikkat hitarar holla lo.'"

content: Zeruzalemot Isa
Ei šob hota hoi bade Isaye hitarar age age Zeruzalemor mikka uṛa šuru goijje.
Bade zẽtte Isa zaitun faharor ato hãse asede Betfage edde Betani farar hãsa hãsi oiye, hetunot hibaye duizon sahabire faṭai diye endilla hoi:

content.text: "Oi sarmor farat zo, heṛe goli mottor ek gadar so banda dekiba, zibar uwore hono manuš hono din no boiye. Hiba kuli ãlla loi anogoi.
Honokiye zodi hiba kiyolla kulor hoi fusar gore, toile endilla hoiba, 'Ibare malikottu dorhar oiye.'"

content: Toi zarare defeṛa oiye, hitara zai Isaye hoiyede mozin hár kissu deikke.
Hitara he gadar so zehon kuilto saiye, giros okkole hitarare fusar goijje, "Tũwara gada sowa kiyolla kulor?"
Hitara giros okkolore hodde, "Iba malikottu dorhar ase."
Tarfore sahabi okkole he gadar soware Isar hãse ainne. Toi hibar fiṛot hitarar hor bisai di, heṛe uwore Isare buwaiye.
Bade Isa zehon za šuru goijje, hẽtte manuš okkole hitarar nizor nizor hor okkolore rastat bisai diya šuru goijje.

Ar Isa zehon Zaitun faharottu lamibar zagar hãsa hãsi fõissegai, hen šomot biššaši okkole ze šob kuduruti ham deikke, hin okkololla kušir sãte guzori guzori hitara beggune Allar tarif goijje. Hitara howa šuru goijje:

content.text: "Rahamot he badšare, ze Malikor name aiyer!"
"Behostot šanti ok ar Uwore Allar mohima ok!"

content: Manušor zamor butottu hoekzon forošiye Isare hodde, "Huzur, õnor sahabi okkolore mana goro."
Kintu Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Ai tũwarare hoir, itara zodi suf take, toile fattorgune guzori uṛibo."

content: Isaye Zeruzalemor hãsa hãsi fõssi šohoror uzu saiye edde hiyanolla sukor fani felaiye.
Ar hodde,

content.text: "Tui aijja o zodi šanti kiye de hiyan buziti, kintu tui no buzor, ehon he šob tor sukor arguwale oi taikke.
Endilla ṭaim aibo zẽtte tor dušmon okkole sairo mikkattu zonzal bandibo, tore giri doribo edde tore šomosto kunattu geruwa goribo.
Ar tore edde tor butoror šontan okkolore meṛi loi fišai felaibo, tor butore uggwa fattoror uwore fattor takito no dibo. Kiyollahoile Allaye tore basaito ze šuzug diye he šomoi tui sini no los."

content: Zeruzalemor dórmogórot Isa
Tarfore Isaye dórmogórot góille edde heṛe zara besa kina goijjil hitarare henttu baire lorai diye.
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Leka ase: 'Ãr gór munazator gór oibo.' Kintu tũwara iyanore ḍahaiṭor aḍḍahana banai felaiyo."

content: Isaye fotti din dórmogórot zai šikka dito. Ar ḍõr imam edde alem ar mainšor neta okkole Isare furai felaibolla kušiš goijje.
Kintu hitara ki bafe hen goribo he ufai tuwai no fa, kiyollahoile manuš beggune diyan di ekmone Isar hota fuinto.
